PUBLIC_URL.description: Public url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

PINRY_SECRET_KEY.description: Generated pinry secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Admin username for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated admin password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Required email address for the initial Pinry administrator. Only used when the database has no users; email delivery is not configured.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for pinry. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for pinry. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for pinry. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
